limitations: Full-report p95 increased from5307ms to6560ms; Arc Mechanics completion dominates the tail. First useful data does not wait for that completion.
One V5 baseline browser ARCY case timed out after30000ms. It is excluded from both matched DOM timing sets, retained as a failure, and not silently retried.

Metric availability did not increase. ARCY/ARGUS each retain four historical holder fields. Twenty Ethereum holder-candidate rows per report are new evidence, not twenty new metrics or owner attributions.
No reviewed named role registry was invented. Non-deterministic address roles remain UNKNOWN.
Per-process telemetry is not durable cross-region observability, and worker heartbeat remains UNKNOWN.
New preview does not inherit existing production DEX permission; no entitlements were changed.
HTTP403/404 and timeouts occurred on optional sources. Passing reports do not mean every upstream request succeeded or all missing metrics were resolved.
